issues.title: Implement stateless player scheduling advisory assessment
issues.body:
## Context

Part of #230. Implement the approved internal Tournament Management assessment described in `openspec/changes/player-scheduling-advisory/` for supplied match, player, timing and rule facts. This domain increment has no caller or organizer interface; integration is future work.

## Requirements and acceptance criteria

- **Assess player overlap from supplied facts:** identify confirmed players in overlapping matches, including confirmed doubles membership; label overlaps based on estimates or proposals as potential and handle adjacent intervals correctly.
- **Assess recovery using a selected rule:** compare actual match end to actual or proposed next start using a caller-supplied duration and authority, edition and applicability reference. Do not infer applicability, waivers, defaults or call-as-start.
- **Represent uncertainty without declaring safety:** report uncertain or missing identity, team membership, times or applicable rule; reject or report invalid or contradictory inputs, never silently normalize them.
- **Reassess changed facts without enforcing scheduling:** assess the supplied snapshot without persistent state or schedule mutation, and reflect delays and corrections on a new request. All findings are advisory.
- Cover the scenarios in the approved OpenSpec delta with meaningful domain tests. Preserve existing REST, JWT, CLI and schema contracts; no frontend, new dependencies or new module. Escalate if these boundaries cannot be maintained.

## Validation

Run `./service/tournamentmgmt/mvnw -B -f 3rd_party/iam/pom.xml install` if shared artifacts are needed, then `./service/tournamentmgmt/mvnw -B -f service/tournamentmgmt/pom.xml clean verify`, `npm run format:check`, explicit Prettier checking of new Markdown, and `npx -y @fission-ai/openspec@1.14.2 validate player-scheduling-advisory --strict`. Record independent checks and follow the lifecycle through UAT and separate merge approval.
